scope: Eight current full menu/HUD pictures at supplied 1920x1080 only; no before images or catalogue grades.

inspection.method: All eight complete originals opened through view_image. No crops/retouching or additional screenshots.

reason: Readable cyan focus and most primary text are positives, but the pictured map does not provide legible terrain/road context, action glyphs are inconsistent between controller and keyboard, Settings viewport instructions are dense/partially clipped, and the exploration HUD/panel presentation is heavy and bare. These eight pictures do not establish the complete controller/device/menu art bar.

images.subject: Exploration HUD
findings: Health/food, time, story objective and keyboard shortcuts are readable.
Large dark story panel and separate shortcut strip cover substantial right-side architecture; the minimap is mostly a cyan field with little route detail.
Shortcut labels show M/I/B and five small numeric binding glyphs rather than an obvious pictured controller action set.
Trainer and near ground remain visible; no gross body burial is established.
images.limits: No HUD behavior, binding availability, actual controller input, device readability or minimap navigation proof.

images.subject: Satchel
images.focus: PASS: cyan slot outline and selected Satchel tab
images.hints: FAIL for complete controller action clarity
findings: Empty-state text, slot count, equipment labels and selected empty slot are readable without visible text overflow.

Footer clearly supplies A/B/LB/RB navigation, but pick-up/put-down instructions use a small keyboard Enter glyph; Quick bar shows J/[L3]. The primary slot action is not consistently conveyed as a controller action.
Panels/grid are very bare in the pictured empty inventory; emptiness is explicitly labeled and is not itself asserted to be a placeholder asset.
Lowest inventory/equipment rows are cut at the scroll viewport; their offscreen content is unassessed.
images.limits: Empty inventory only; item art, populated long names, full grid, equipment models and scrolling behavior are absent.

images.subject: Quests
images.focus: PASS: Research log action cyan outlined; selected Quests tab
findings: Research log, current objective/route instruction, local requests and bounty empty-state text are readable.
No pictured long-line overflow or overlapping cards; footer controller tab/select/close hints remain readable.
Secondary headings/text are subdued but still legible in this full-resolution picture; presentation is a broad text-led dark panel.
images.limits: Only this quest/empty-state content; no research-log screen, expanded quest details, selection movement or device proof.

images.subject: Build overview
images.focus: PASS: Open Build Menu cyan outline
findings: Tent, Campfire and Bedroll names, descriptions and costs fit their cards; no visible text overflow.
Three object images distinguish the categories, though small/dark and coarse in finish, especially the faceted fire.
The instruction and primary button are readable; bottom A/B/LB/RB hints remain clear.
images.limits: Overview only; no opened catalogue, placement preview, actual build interaction, populated recipe inventory or mechanics proof.

images.subject: Players
images.focus: PASS: selected Players tab has cyan outline
findings: Trainer portrait and identity text are distinct and readable.
The pictured unavailable-joining message is readable and not clipped; no cause or actual networking outcome is inferred beyond the displayed text.
Large unused central area yields a bare presentation, but the single pictured player/status state is understandable.
images.limits: No multiple-player roster, invitation/join controls in an available state, co-op or runtime network verification.

images.subject: Settings/Controls viewport
images.focus: PASS: Left stick up binding cyan outlined
findings: Controls heading, reset button, rebinding instruction, Gamepad/Keyboard columns and Walk forward row are readable.
An instruction paragraph is clipped mid-line at the top of the content viewport; the visible remainder is dense and spans almost the whole width.
The viewport exposes only one movement binding after a large text area/vertical gap. The complete control list and earlier settings are absent.
Footer controller hints remain clear, but the pictured binding instructions mix pad, keyboard and long prose.
images.limits: A partially scrolled viewport only; no assertion that hidden text is permanently clipped, no other control rows or changed binding behavior.

images.subject: Settings/Controls viewport
images.focus: PASS: Left stick up binding cyan outlined
findings: Same visible Controls/Walk forward context as 06; selected binding and main labels are legible.
Top paragraph is again cut across a line at the viewport edge; dense full-width instructions and blank spacing limit the pictured hierarchy.
No additional binding/state coverage is supplied by this picture.
images.limits: Independent pictured observation only; no byte-identity, before/after repair comparison or scroll behavior inference.

images.subject: Map
images.focus: PASS: selected map tab/region has cyan emphasis
images.terrain_context: FAIL for the pictured local map
images.hints: FAIL for clear controller-only action grouping
findings: Cloudreach Cliffs, Surveyed: 0% and 32x local view are legible.
The map shows a very small blurred cyan/green patch around the marker in a large black field; no road, terrain contour or landmark context is legible in that patch.
Action hints mix A/X/Right Stick with [Minus]/[Equal]/[Comma]/[Period]. The last pair wraps awkwardly over two lines and the common footer sits very close to the image bottom.
No terrain detail is assumed beyond what is visible; the unsurveyed black region is not automatically labeled a placeholder.
images.limits: Only the pictured 0%-surveyed, 32x local view; no zoom/pan/surveyed-region, navigation, marker or motion proof.

literal_artifacts.gross_scene_body_burial: Not visibly established in 01 or dimmed backgrounds
literal_artifacts.text_clipping: Settings 06/07 show a partial line at the top content boundary; behavior outside these static viewports is unassessed
literal_artifacts.map_placeholder_claim: Not asserted: black is explicitly unsurveyed; the visible local patch still lacks readable road/terrain detail
literal_artifacts.inventory_placeholder_claim: Not asserted: slots/equipment are explicitly empty
literal_artifacts.other_floating_or_geometry_clipping: No supported all-scene absence claim from menus; much of the world is obscured/dimmed.

owning_requirements: Controller focus and action hints must be obvious; labels/content must be legible.
UI/HUD should maintain clear hierarchy and readable world context without excessive heavy billboard clutter.
Reference-backed, intentional presentation; empty/unsurveyed state alone does not establish placeholder art.
limits: Debug travel/staged chapter party with menus opened through the existing producer; not earned campaign or functional input proof.
One 1920x1080 resolution only. No seven-inch/device, alternate layout/text scale, motion, scrolling, focus traversal or co-op evidence.
No source/config/manifest/log/runtime-source/private binding or hypothesis read; no implementation cause inferred.
No before-repair comparison, particularly for Settings/Controls. No catalogue scores, whole F40/F42 or READY promotion.
Existing whole failures and previous diagnoses remain untouched.
